name: final-speed-baseline

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: decode x6 runs: every reply produced and equal to the pinned/solo reply, concurrent == solo
prefill x2 runs: cold 32K, 128K, 224K replies equal to the pinned replies

commands: ./inkling2mini.sh bench pin   (boot p: decode, c=4/c=8, cold 32K/128K/224K)
./inkling2mini.sh bench all   (boot g: decode, c=4/c=8, rolling, cold 32K/128K/224K)
notes: Shipping defaults (SPEC=dspark PREFIX_CACHE=on VISION=on), profile bootstrap, GPU capped at 2,200 MHz. Medians over every run that measured the metric: decode over p-pin, g-all, g-pass2-decode, g-pass2-rolling, g-pass3-decode, g-pass3-rolling; prefill over p-pin, g-all (each run starts with its own discarded warm-up). The numbers are single-boot figures per boot; the spread is in the per-run metrics.txt.
